newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: ARA bunkers head up again, Med broadly stable.
newsitem.headline: ARA bunkers head up again, Med broadly stable.

text.p: Rotterdam bunker prices edged slightly higher on Thursday following further barge market strength, while bunkers in much of the rest of Europe were steady, dealers said.
Rotterdam 380 CST bunkers gained about $1 to $88/$89 fob after one trading house bought heavily in the barge market, driving prices to around $87.
A few buyers covered enquiries in the morning, but activity dried up later. One buyer sought around 10,000 tonnes in Flushing, but seemed prepared to wait until next week, suppliers said.
Hamburg prices were broadly stable, although there were fewer discounts available than on Thursday.
Spanish bunkers shuffled $1 higher, while France and Italy were steady.
Egyptian bunkers were $1 a tonne higher. Supplies in Port Said were expected to return to normal.
